glider 6.13.0-preview.16
A semantic C#/.NET code navigation and refactoring MCP server (stdio or HTTP).
Requires .NET 10 SDK.

Usage:
  glider [--transport stdio|http] [--port <n>] [--default-timeout <duration>] [--build-host <auto|netframework|netcore>] [--msbuild-path <path>] [--verbose]
  glider --version
  glider --help

Options:
  --transport <stdio|http>   Transport to use (default: stdio).
  --port <n>                 HTTP port (default: 5001).
  --default-timeout <value>  Default timeout for async tools (default: 20m). Use 0 to disable.
                             Supported units: ms, s, m (for example: 10ms, 10s, 10m).
  --build-host <value>       Roslyn build-host mode (default: auto). Valid options: auto, netframework, netcore.
  --msbuild-path <path>      Explicit MSBuild location. Point to a directory containing MSBuild.exe or MSBuild.dll,
                             or to one of those files directly.
  --verbose                  Enable logging.
  --version, -v              Print version and exit.
  --help, -h                 Show this help and exit.

Examples:
  glider
  glider --default-timeout 30m
  glider --transport http
  glider --build-host netframework --verbose
  glider --build-host netframework --msbuild-path "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\MSBuild\Current\Bin"
  glider --transport http --port 8080 --default-timeout 45s
